staff_closure.loading.defaultMessage: 正在加载停止服务信息…
staff_closure.loading.description: In place of the closure's screens while the closure is read. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.announcement.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the section of the announcement of the closure. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.none.defaultMessage: 尚未发布停止服务公告。
staff_closure.none.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), while no closure is announced. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.withdraw.text.defaultMessage: 服务器将照常运行，所有用户都会收到通知和电子邮件。已拒绝的注册和已结束的支持者订阅不会恢复。

staff_closure.progress.description: On the closure's screen of the administration (/admin/closure), the heading of the progress of the delivery of the deletion of every local account. Read by administrators.

Read by administrators.

staff_closure.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, due {已过关闭日期} other {已公告}}

staff_closure.form.message.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), the heading of the section of the operator's message, shown in the notices and on the closed server's page. Read by administrators.

staff_closure.form.short.description: On the form of the closure's announcement (/admin/closure/announcement), beside the button when the closing date is less than 30 days away. Read by administrators.
